text:
Great! I found your order #W8661412 which is still pending, so I can help you change the water bottle. I can see you currently have a 500ml black stainless steel water bottle.

For the 1000ml option, I have these available choices:
- 1000ml stainless steel, black ($46.51) - this would save you $6.28
- 1000ml stainless steel, red ($49.51) - this would save you $3.28

Which 1000ml option would you prefer - black or red?

Also, I'll need to use your payment method (Visa ending in 8676) to process the refund for the price difference. Is that okay?
zh:
太好了！我找到了你的订单#W8661412，它还在处理中，所以我可以帮你换水瓶。我看到你现在有一个500毫升黑色不锈钢水瓶。

对于1000毫升的选项，我这里有以下选择：
- 1000毫升不锈钢，黑色($46.51) - 这会帮你省下$6.28
- 1000毫升不锈钢，红色($49.51) - 这会帮你省下$3.28

你更喜欢哪个1000毫升的选项 - 黑色还是红色？

另外，我需要使用你的支付方式（Visa ending in 8676）来处理价格差额的退款。可以吗？
